capabilities: Control Spotify playback from a now-playing sidebar
Display time-synced lyrics from LRCLIB with click-to-seek
Browse the upcoming queue and search tracks, albums, and playlists
Capture the current track and lyrics into templated notes or .lrc files
Play Spotify URIs or URLs under the cursor via a bindable command
extras: Mobile support is tagged "preview" with known differences (no hover controls, plaintext token storage). Spotify Premium is required to control playback and to own the developer app; Free accounts are limited to capture/display features. Notable limitations documented: no in-Obsidian audio playback (Widevine DRM missing from Electron), no Smart Shuffle control, tokens may be stored plaintext on mobile or headless Linux.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see or control Spotify playback or to capture what you're listening to into notes.
